Name: Eregion Glorfindel Response
Description: V-17 (SEC7): the writes of Glorfindel's response only - isolate and release a VM (its NICs, the quarantine NSG and its rules, the sessions cut by Run Command), block and unblock an IP (deny rules), an on-demand backup (snapshot). Never a restore, a deletion, an identity or a role. Assigned on each resource group that holds an enrolled VM, its NICs, NSGs and VNet, and on the vault's. Reads come from Reader and Log Analytics Reader.
